Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Direction: Direction pixels are sorted toward. right, left, up or down.
Key: Value pixels are sorted by. luma: brightness. hue: hue. sat: saturation. red: red channel.
Thresholdlow: Pixels darker than this (by Key) are not sorted and act as span breaks.
Thresholdhigh: Pixels brighter than this (by Key) are not sorted and act as span breaks.
Passes: Sort passes per frame (max 16). More = faster, longer-reaching sorting.
Sortamount: Blend from the source (0) to the sorted image (1).
Refresh: Per-frame pull of the sort state back toward the live source. Higher keeps moving video recognisable.
Bytebeat: Strength of the bytebeat XOR bit-corruption bands. 0 = off.
Bandsize: Height of the corruption bands. Larger = fewer, thicker bands.
Bandholdframes: Number of frames each corruption band pattern persists before changing.
Shuffle: Amount of per-block colour channel shuffling. 0 = off.
Seed: Random seed for the channel shuffle pattern.
Active: On: sorting runs. Off: freezes the sort state.
Reset: Pulse: re-seed the sort state from the current source.
Modamount: Strength of the in2 modulation CHOP (band1 adds to Bytebeat). 0 = ignore.
